items.title: Release npm version 0.4.1 with ROS attribution
Documentation audit and reconstruction: rewrite README/AGENTS, add docs/ set, six verified examples, docs+example CI verification
Limen productization: name the kernel Limen in human-facing surfaces, rewrite README/AGENTS front door, preserve compatibility-sensitive identifiers
Fix kernel silent-failure defects P-1/P-2, packaging D-9, transport clarity A-1; publish evidence findings
Limen showcase site: Echelon Foundry identity, interactive demos driven by real Limen, Pages deployment
Standardized Echelon lifecycle CLI: F# core + npm bootstrap for init/status/verify/upgrade/doctor
items.description: Add an F#-implemented, npm-distributed lifecycle CLI (init, status, verify, upgrade, doctor) with a minimal Node bootstrap, installation manifest, file-ownership model, JSON output and stable exit codes, without changing existing library behavior.

items.title: Document the lifecycle conversion: CLI reference, installation and ownership, conversion report
items.description: Write docs/20-lifecycle-cli.md, docs/21-installation-and-upgrade.md and docs/22-lifecycle-conversion-report.md, and correct the .NET availability entry in the documentation audit.

items.title: Make --verbose meaningful on verify, init and upgrade
items.description: The flag was documented on every command but only changed status output. Wire it through verify and the lifecycle commands, and test that it changes what is printed.

items.title: Record cross-platform CI results in the CLI documentation
items.description: The packaged-CLI matrix has run on Linux, Windows and macOS. Replace the 'untested' statements with the measured results, and state precisely which two shipped binaries have never been executed.

items.title: Release 0.5.0: first release carrying the Limen lifecycle CLI
items.description: Bump the package to 0.5.0 (minor: the npm package gains bin entries and five platform binaries; the library surface is unchanged and additive) and tag it so the publish workflow builds, validates and publishes the archive.

items.title: Record the hosted-sandbox git and toolchain limits in CLAUDE.md
items.description: Tag pushes and ref deletions are blocked by the session git proxy while branch pushes succeed; the .NET SDK is available via the Ubuntu archive. Record both, plus the two consequences (releases must be tagged by a human; a scratch branch is permanent and cancels main's CI) so the next agent does not rediscover them.

items.title: Fix the release workflow: npm pack --pack-destination needs the directory to exist
items.description: The v0.5.0 publish failed at the pack step with ENOENT because --pack-destination does not create its target directory. Create it first, and verify the remaining pack/verify/exercise chain locally since those steps had never executed.

items.title: Release 0.5.1: republish after the v0.5.0 pack failure
items.description: v0.5.0 never published because the pack step failed with ENOENT, and its tag cannot be deleted or moved. Bump to 0.5.1 so the fixed publish workflow can release from a fresh tag.

npm packaging: ship documentation and a minimal example, verify tarball contents, add a clean-room consumer check
Surface the new capabilities and documents on the Limen site, and record the usability report
Sweep the documents the new capabilities made stale, add BrowserLocation.origin, and guard against the recurrence
Record the decision to defer Playwright adoption rather than leave it an open question
Release as 0.6.1: the v0.6.0 tag was pushed at the pre-merge commit and cannot be re-pointed
Rework the Limen site around product value, architectural clarity, verified evidence, and honest WASM status
Reconcile Limen self-hosting with current Echelon capabilities
Define and implement federated multi-WASM modules with typed transitions
items.description: Add first-class Limen federation so independently loaded application engines can own bounded state, exchange versioned typed envelopes, request cross-module transitions without shared mutable state, coordinate lifecycle, and be tested deterministically.

items.title: Complete GitHub repository rename from typescript-wasm-kernel to Limen
items.description: Migrate repository identity, GitHub URLs, Pages URL, package repository metadata, documentation, and validation assumptions to kemiller2002/limen while preserving the published npm package name and legacy CLI executable as compatibility surfaces.

items.title: Demonstrate federation with two independent F# WebAssembly modules
items.description: Build a real multi-F#-WASM federation existence proof using two independently published .NET WebAssembly runtimes behind Limen ModuleFederation. Prove versioned cross-module transition request/response, state ownership, typed F# contract decoding, independent runtime identity, snapshots, and real-browser execution without moving domain authority into TypeScript.

items.title: Add federation failure isolation and diagnostics
items.description: Make multi-module Limen federation production-safe when a module transport fails. Add an explicit faulted lifecycle state, semantically blind module diagnostics, and isolated startup that continues independent modules while blocking dependents of failed modules. Preserve existing fail-fast startAll behavior and do not invent domain recovery.
